site.name: Festival Planner
site.tagline: Timetables you can actually plan with. One page per festival, works offline once loaded.

festivals.name: Flow Festival
festivals.description: Three days in a former power plant by the sea. Ten stages, from the Main Stage under the gasholders to all-night dance floors in the yards.

festivals.name: Kallio Block Party
festivals.description: One free day across the streets of Alppila. Nine independently run stages, from a live band stage by Linnanmäki to hard techno on Kirstinkatu.

festivals.name: Helsinki Biennial
festivals.description: Site-specific commissions spread across an old garrison island, shown alongside the fortifications and meadows they were made for.

festivals.name: Love & Anarchy
festivals.description: Around 200 features and shorts from the year's festival circuit, with director talks and a late-night strand that runs past midnight.

facts.place: Bio Rex, Kinopalatsi, Orion and two more

festivals.name: Blockfest
festivals.description: The Nordics' largest hip-hop festival, two days at the Ratina stadium and the event park beside it.
festivals.previewNote: Blockfest has published its line-up and the names of its three stages, not its running order. Set times appear on blockfest.fi closer to the weekend.

festivals.name: Helsinki Festival
festivals.description: The largest arts festival in the Nordic countries: opera, orchestral music, theatre and world music across the city for nineteen days.
festivals.previewNote: Helsinki Festival runs several hundred events across the city over two and a half weeks. Its programme is on helsinkifestival.fi; none of it is transcribed here yet.

festivals.name: Espoo Ciné
festivals.description: Ten days of new Finnish and international cinema, centred on Kino Tapiola and screening across Espoo and Helsinki.
festivals.previewNote: Espoo Ciné publishes screening times per film rather than as a grid. The programme is on espoocine.fi; none of it is transcribed here yet.

festivals.name: Lost In Music
festivals.description: Two evenings across Tampere's own venues — Tavara-asema, Telakka, G Livelab, Olympia and more — on one wristband.
festivals.previewNote: Lost In Music has published which artists play which venue, but not when — the festival says the detailed timetable comes closer to the event.

festivals.name: Tampere Jazz Happening
festivals.description: Four days of contemporary jazz, long known for its warm room and its broad idea of what the music can be.
festivals.previewNote: Tampere Jazz Happening publishes its running order closer to the weekend. The venues are here; the clock is not.
